dedupe_keys.name: tomp api transport operator to mobility as a service provider api standard

description: The Transport Operator to Mobility-as-a-Service Provider API (TOMP-API) is an open standard for technical communication between transport operators and Mobility-as-a-Service providers, developed and maintained by the TOMP working group. It defines the interface between the two sides; the README points to full API documentation and monthly working group meetings, with a secretariat at the MaaS Alliance. Coverage: any operator and MaaS platform. Format and access: an API specification in a public repository. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: a message standard without data; the README excerpt read does not list adopters, and implementations vary by version. It supports digital twin and network flow studies that need to connect multimodal operators through a common interface. It relates to the Transmodel, NeTEx and SIRI standards and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
